objective: Audit positive odd-cycle exponent words through canonical coprime slope profiles, exact resultants, radial energy, and Christoffel source bounds without conflating a finite obstruction with exclusion of every nontrivial cycle.

quantifiers: all primitive positive odd cycles for P133 and P134
all positive-exponent cyclic words with gcd(L,q)=1 for P135 through P138
all non-Christoffel coprime cyclic words only under EXT15 for P139
all positive-exponent words after a minimum-height rotation for the weaker noncoprime P140 reduction
all positive exponent compositions with q<=8 and q<L<=2q for the exhaustive part of E34
all valid coprime canonical profiles of defect area at most 2 with q<=22 and q<L<=2q for the bounded-profile part of E34
exact_scope.completeness: The composition audit is exhaustive only through q=8. The q<=22 audit is exhaustive only inside defect area at most 2. Resultants are generated by multiplication matrices and independently cross-checked by Sylvester determinants on every exhaustive coprime row and a deterministic sample of the larger area-bounded audit. No finite coverage is promoted to an eventual cycle theorem.

arithmetic.exact_methods: arbitrary-precision integers, exact rational radial-root enclosures, Bareiss determinants, divisibility, and integer power comparisons

verifier_reconstructs: accelerated affine corrections, literal cycle legality, and minimum rotations
canonical profiles from residue-indexed heights and the modular slope root
resultants with a Sylvester determinant rather than the generator multiplication matrix
exact radial-energy enclosures with an independently written bisection
every declared composition and area-bounded profile count and row digest
the trivial positive cycle and both named negative-cycle regressions

stop_conditions: Do not apply the coprime profile bijection or degree-q resultant without gcd(L,q)=1.
Do not treat a rational affine fixed point as a literal integer cycle without checking divisibility and exact valuations.
Do not use floating-point energy or logarithms for an acceptance decision.
Keep EXT05 and EXT15 dependencies explicit, and do not interpret Knight high cycles as all Collatz cycles.
Keep the positive nontrivial-cycle branch OPEN unless every coprime and noncoprime profile is eliminated.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before changing proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: Area zero and all coprime area-one positive profiles are excluded, but profiles of larger area and the full noncoprime branch remain.
The finite combined energy/source audit is obstruction mining, not an asymptotic theorem.
H133, H89, H112, H72, the positive nontrivial-cycle branch, and Collatz remain open; proves_collatz remains false.
